raw_case_text: On January 6, 2018, a 5-month-old male presented with a 4-day history of fever to the emergency room at the Jurua Regional Hospital and was diagnosed with Plasmodium falciparum by microscopy. The patient was treated following the Brazilian Ministry of Health national treatment guidelines: 3 days of twice daily Coartem (fixed combination of artemether (20 mg) and lumefantrine (120 mg)).

subjective.chief_complaint: A 5-month-old male infant presented to the emergency room in Brazil with a 4-day history of fever.
subjective.history_of_present_illness: The infant was brought to the emergency department at Jurua Regional Hospital on January 6, 2018, following 4 days of fever.

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation: Final diagnosis: Uncomplicated Plasmodium falciparum malaria in a 5-month-old infant. Confirmed by peripheral blood microscopy. Treated per Brazilian Ministry of Health guidelines with a 3-day course of twice-daily oral artemether-lumefantrine (Coartem 20 mg/120 mg fixed-dose combination).
